title: Palace Pass
tagline: A ticket booking API for Mysuru Palace entry slots during Dasara

in: Seat capacity rules and input validation

rules: AI tools are allowed. Say what you used in ai.md.
Build it yourself: copied projects are caught because the Live Round uses your own code.
About 4 hours of work. Don't over-build.
Your code stays yours (MIT). Companies only see your proof, not your repo rights.
summary: During Dasara, lakhs of visitors come to Mysuru Palace. Build the backend that lets visitors see time slots, book tickets and cancel bookings, without ever selling more tickets than a slot can hold.
requirements: GET /slots lists every entry slot with its capacity and seats available
POST /bookings books tickets for a slot and returns the booking with its total price (₹100 per ticket)
A slot can never be overbooked (409 when there aren't enough seats)
Invalid requests return 400 with a helpful error message
GET /bookings/:id returns a booking, DELETE /bookings/:id cancels it and frees the seats
Write your own tests, a short architecture note and a decision log
contract: src/server.js must export createServer() returning a Node http.Server that is not yet listening
Each createServer() call starts with fresh seed data: DASARA-1000 (40 seats), DASARA-1400 (40 seats), LIGHTS-1900 (60 seats)

evaluation.label: Docs & claims
evaluation.detail: README claims are checked against the code

evaluation.label: Live Round
evaluation.detail: 3 missions inside your own code + viva

mutations.describe: Changes the capacity check from > to >= so the last seats can never be sold

missions.title: Bug Hunt

story.headline: "Sold out" with seats still free
story.message: Visitors are angry. The 10:00 AM slot shows 2 seats left, but when a family books exactly 2 tickets, the system says the slot is sold out. We've planted this bug somewhere in your code. Find it and fix it.
logs: 10:02:14  POST /bookings  tickets=2   409  Not enough seats left in this slot

missions.goal: Make the last seats of a slot bookable again, without allowing overbooking. Bonus: add a test to your own tests/ that would have caught this bug.
hints: The bug is where your code decides whether a slot has enough seats.
Compare the operator in the capacity check with what "exactly full" should mean.
If 38 are booked and 2 more are requested, 38 + 2 = 40 must be allowed for a 40-seat slot.

missions.title: Customer Complaint

story.headline: Someone booked -3 tickets
story.message: Last night's report shows a booking of -3 tickets with a total of ₹-300. The slot's seat count also went up by 3. Your code reviewer already flagged this. Fix it so bad ticket counts are rejected.

missions.goal: Reject bookings unless tickets is a whole number from 1 to 10. Return 400 with a clear error message.
hints: Check the ticket count before you touch the slot.
Number.isInteger(tickets) rejects "2abc", 2.5 and missing values in one go.
Throw your existing 400 error type so routes.js turns it into JSON.

missions.title: Plot Twist

story.headline: Dasara pricing changes tonight
story.message: New rules start at midnight. Children under 12 pay ₹50 and adults pay ₹100. Groups of 5 or more people get 10% off. Every booking needs at least 1 adult and at most 10 people. Old apps still send { tickets }, so treat that as adults.

missions.goal: Support adults and children with the new prices. All old tests must keep passing. Fewer files changed means your design handled the change well.
hints: Start by deciding where the new request fields are read and turned into a people count.
Your pricing rules may already live in one place. Can calculatePrice take adults and children?
Seats booked must be adults + children, and cancelling must free the same number.
